name: Adaptive Voxelization
definition: An adaptive voxelization algorithm tailored to 3DGS data that selects higher resolution for regions containing large-volume Gaussians or regions with higher voxelization errors, and lower resolution for regions with dense Gaussians, to avoid inefficiencies of uniform voxelization.
summary: Adaptive Voxelization dynamically adjusts voxel resolution based on Gaussian volume and spatial redundancy to reduce data size, unlike uniform methods that apply fixed depth.
